instruction: Find the page about vehicle registration and titling

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from Virginia DMV homepage to the vehicle registration/titling page. Uses the same evaluator pattern as original (URL regex match via accessibility tree). Similar complexity - requires 1-2 navigation clicks. Regex allows for path variations.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts active URL from accessibility tree, which is the right state to verify after navigation
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly performs regex matching on the URL
Expected regex pattern '^https://(www\.)?dmv\.virginia\.gov/(vehicles|services)/(registration|titling|title)' accurately identifies vehicle registration/titling pages
Pattern allows appropriate flexibility: optional 'www.' prefix and multiple valid path variations (vehicles/services sections, registration/titling/title endpoints)
Evaluator provides complete coverage: instruction requires finding registration/titling page, evaluator verifies URL matches such pages
Logic is sound and will work correctly at runtime - no edge case issues for this straightforward URL verification task
